evidence.rationale: File owns original source evidence and immutable bytes; Intelligence owns the separate processing lifecycle and retained interpretation evidence.

concepts.definition: Repository-scoped protected original file identity; head selects an immutable revision. Format-neutral, not a Contract, Content plan or public attachment.

Immutable authorized File source revision: exact external private-object bytes identified by Repository/File/Revision, declared media type, size, SHA-256, actor and timestamp. A revision is committed only after content readback; edits and processing never replace its object.

Durable immutable source/attempt metadata and digest committed before private object I/O. A database-clock retry window and operator-only quarantine fence deletion of never-committed Storage objects; every independently verified absence refreshes a durable reconciliation cursor because an unknown write may complete later. FileCommandReceipt alone proves finalization.
Legacy processing run storage retained only for historical read during controlled cutover; Intelligence owns all new runs.
Immutable legacy processing revisions retained for historical reads during controlled cutover.
Legacy File request receipt retained only for historical File storage evidence. Current processing receipts belong to Intelligence.

relationships.meaning: Contract transactionally requalifies one exact authorized File revision and SHA-256 before persisting a ContractDocument revision. File retains original-byte, storage and access authority; Contract stores only the immutable source reference in its own revision.

Intelligence reads an exact File revision only through File's public source reader, which authorizes before and after private object I/O. Intelligence receives detached bytes and no File persistence or storage authority.

capabilities.intent: Preserve protected Repository-scoped files via explicit durable Upload Intent, private immutable Storage Object readback, atomic File revision/head/receipt Finalize and exact replay; list/read/download require current access.

implementation.scope: Preserve protected Repository-scoped files via explicit durable Upload Intent, private immutable Storage Object readback, atomic File revision/head/receipt Finalize and exact replay; list/read/download require current access.
implementation.note: Authenticated CLI preserves originals up to 45 MiB. Web/LINE Repository Files transport uses bounded 3 MB signed private-object upload with trusted server-side digest readback and authenticated JSON Finalize, bounded 3 MB server-authorized Download, and current-authorized File List; private Supabase Storage remains the only bytes store. Processing lifecycle and result history are Intelligence-owned. No large-file Web transport, live device/production acceptance or business import is asserted.
